answers.scope: Standalone cc_stream_fifo with source default parameters; focused subtree only.

boundary_trust.both_package_and_child_missing: The standalone default FallThrough, DataWidth, Depth and data_t resolve; UsageWidth is unset. Semantic writes still identify the two wrapper assignments, whose RHS expressions are confirmed in source. The child is not elaborated and its state or status behavior cannot be established from that fragment.
boundary_trust.package_present_child_missing: The wrapper defaults and UsageWidth=4 resolve even though cc_fifo is an unknown module. The child is absent from the elaborated children list; this is a missing-definition boundary, not proof the source has no child. Child effective parameters, connections and stored state cannot be verified from this fragment alone.
boundary_trust.child_present_package_missing: The fifo_i child elaborates and independent parameters FallThrough=0, DataWidth=32, Depth=8, data_t and FifoDepth=8 resolve. Both top and child UsageWidth and child PtrWidth are unset, and the child usage_o connection has an error type and unknown width. Package-dependent width and layout claims are not trustworthy until the package is available.
boundary_trust.both_present: The complete focused source set resolves the child and all reported widths, parameters, connections and four always_ff-written state elements. This is still a fragment with completeness not verified.

evidence.observations: UnknownClassOrPackage cc_pkg at line 22 and UnknownModule cc_fifo at line 50; UsageWidth <unset>; no elaborated children. get_signal_writes identifies continuous writes to push and pop at cc_stream_fifo.sv:45 and :46.
One UnknownModule cc_fifo error; top UsageWidth=4; children list empty.

evidence.experiment: cc_fifo.sv + cc_stream_fifo.sv, with includes but without cc_pkg.sv
evidence.observations: Three UnknownClassOrPackage errors, two PackedArrayConv warnings; fifo_i exists, independent child parameters resolve, UsageWidth and PtrWidth are <unset>, and usage_o has <error> type and null width.

Zero errors and two PackedArrayConv warnings. inspect_instance reports child parameters and connections; get_state_elements reports read_pointer_q, write_pointer_q, status_cnt_q and mem_q as four always_ff-written signals with widths 3, 3, 4 and 256.

get_signal_reads identifies valid_i and full at cc_stream_fifo.sv:45, ready_i and empty at :46, full at :47, and empty at :48. Exact operators and RHS are checked in cc_stream_fifo.sv:45-48; child port connections are supported by call 15.

evidence.observation: Source inspection confirms the constant functions, expressions, parameter forwarding, declarations and register macro call sites; semantic server results establish elaboration and state classification.

limitations: All values are for the standalone top defaults; parent instance overrides and the rest of the project were not analyzed.
Missing-definition experiments are intentionally erroneous; their diagnostics and unresolved values must not be treated as evidence that the complete design lacks a child or that a width equals zero.
The final fragment has two unresolved PackedArrayConv warnings at cc_fifo.sv:126, both reporting implicit conversion from logic[255:0] to logic[7:0][31:0]. No errors were reported.

The state query identifies always_ff writes; it does not infer reset semantics or synthesis memory implementation. Equations are reconstructed from semantically identified source locations and verified in source; this is not full connectivity analysis.
Twenty successful tools/call requests were used, plus tools/list; the server reports fragment completeness as not verified.
